_comment: Template for API keys. Copy this file to api_keys.json and fill in your actual keys. api_keys.json is gitignored - your real keys will NOT be committed.

_instructions.1: If you have Copilot Pro or Antigravity, you don't need any keys below - just leave them empty.
_instructions.2: Otherwise, paste your API keys for the providers you want to use.
_instructions.plane: Plane → Profile → Personal Access Tokens (used by qa-run)

anthropic._comment: Claude API key (used by testcase-template, playwright-pom-automation)

openai._comment: OpenAI API key (used by AI helpers in qa-run)

plane._comment: Plane API token (used by qa-run for ticket fetching)
